lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_storm: On the wall at the entrance to the copper circuit room. Only that stretch of wall is unscorched.
On the wall at the entrance to the room of the charged chain. Only the last line is carved shallow, as if in a hurry.

On the wall at the entrance to the deck where the thunder feathers are carried. The wind running through the bones whistles thinly in the grooves of the letters.

On the wall beside it is a small carving of a person. Its head is square.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.raiju.body: When the beast fell, the lightning gathered in the knuckle had nowhere to go, and ran from rod to rod, again and again. At last the rods fell quiet.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.raiju.title: The Raiju
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_cower.body: While the sky shadow passed, the thunder wing clung to the peak with its head hidden under its wings. A bird the size of a mountain was afraid.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.keep_prev_page.bo:
A loose leaf from a ledger at the back of the Skywatch keep, stamped with the sky-watchers' seal. The hand looks familiar.

"Afternoon. A storm came down on the north peak. I put my hand to the bell rope, and let go. Not the shadow. The shadow makes no sound.

I counted the wing flash three times in the storm. I did not count the fourth. Counting it, I feel it would look back.

To whoever stands watch next: do not mistake the storm for the shadow. The storm, for now, is still on our side."

... The way the strokes end is the same as your own.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_cower.title: The Cowering Titan
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_ruins.body:
Two stone towers stood on the bird's back. Their walls are cut with short strokes, more than anyone could count.

No one was there. Wardens in copper helms walked the hollow bones. Behind the helms there was nothing.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_ruins.title: Ruins of the Wind Folk
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_stilled.bod:
The thunder wing's heart stopped. The wind deep in its chest fell still for the first time.

Above the storm, the sky had been clear all along. Even so, the bird never shed its storm.

Laid side by side in my palm, the three fragments drew together, tilting slightly downward.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_wing.body:
A distant storm was moving upwind. Each time the lightning flashed, the shape of wings showed inside the curtain of rain.

The wings were smaller than the sky shadow's.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.storm_wing.title: The Storm Against the Wind
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.wind_ledger.body:
Calms and storms are tallied in strokes. From one day on, a small mark begins to appear beside them. It seems to mean: do not look up.

On the last page, there are no strokes at all.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.wind_ledger.title: The Wind Ledger

message.skyabyss.storm.perching: The wind has turned. The storm is coming down onto the peak...
message.skyabyss.storm.summit_noticed: The thunder wing has noticed you on the peak. The wind spirals down...
message.skyabyss.storm.taking_off: The thunder wing spreads its wings. The hour of the squall is over
message.skyabyss.storm.trials_renewed: The thunder wing's heart beats again, a beat returning from deep beneath the ground. The trials on its back are as they were

message.skyabyss.storm_heart.descend: You go down below the keel gate. A beat like thunder rises from beneath
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.go: Gather in the keel antechamber (down the spiral below the keel gate)
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.pillar: The pillar of light carried you to the tail chamber
message.skyabyss.storm_heart.reward: What the thunder wing's heart left behind has passed into your hands
message.skyabyss.weathercock.called: Lightning struck the weathercock. The storm has noticed you

message.skyabyss.weathercock.no_sky: You can't see the sky. Go out from under the roof

quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.rounds: A note on the board, the ink run a little by rain: "Inside the bones on the bird's back, the copper-helmed wardens and the glowing moths are stirring again. Quiet eight of them."
Defeat feather wardens, moths and supplicants on the thunder wing
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.summar: Defeat eight feather wardens, static moths or thunder supplicants on the thunder wing's back. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_storm_rounds.title: Rounds on the Thunder Wing
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.done: The storm has stopped. But the wind will gather again, surely.
A note in the corner of the board, in the same unsigned hand: "The storm comes back in seven days. Go and make sure, before it is back."
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.summar: Still the thunder wing's heart once more. Party members in the fight count too.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_storm_heart.title: The Storm's Heart, Once More

lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_storm: On the wall at the entrance to the deck where the pillar walks. Beside the lines are three small key-shaped holes.
On the wall at the entrance to the hall of lit tiles. Under the lines runs a row of shallow footprints.
Inscription of the Eye of the Storm
On the wall at the entrance to the gale hall. The last line stops short, as if the carver had set down the chisel.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR4.1: A pillar of lightning is walking the deck. What is it guarding, and from whom?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR4.2: Three keys. What did the wind folk lock away?
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR5.1: I can feel a beat through the soles of my feet. Perhaps this floor was tuned to the bird's heart.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR5.2: Along the edge of the floor, tally marks are bundled in fours. The wind folk were not only counting the beat.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR6.1: The wind blows out from the centre. Lightning comes from above, but the beat rises from beneath my feet.
message.skyabyss.raid_lore.SR6.2: For a moment I thought I saw someone's face deep inside that keeper's helm.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR4.desc: A pillar of lightning walks the copper deck after the nearest player. It stops, draws a red beam ahead, and strikes. Collect the three keys scattered around the deck. The pillar is slower than you, and pillars and walls block the beam. Splitting up is faster, since it can chase only one of you.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR5.desc: Nine copper tiles light up in order, on a beat. Remember the order and step on the same tiles on the beat. The sequence grows each round (four in all). Stepping on a wrong tile or missing the beat replays the round. No damage. Waiting on the next tiles with your friends while the sequence plays is faster.
trial.skyabyss.cell.SR6.desc: Gusts blow outward from the centre of a round copper hall. When the warning appears, shelter behind a pillar and advance in the lulls. Defeat the keeper of the eye at the centre. Each gust brings thunder moths.
raid.skyabyss.SR4.keys: Collect the three glowing keys (follow the light; a lightning pillar hunts you, dodge its red beam)
raid.skyabyss.SR5.watch: Watch: remember the order the tiles light up
raid.skyabyss.SR5.step: Now step on the tiles in the same order, one per beat (other tiles fail the round)
raid.skyabyss.SR6.advance: Advance into the eye and defeat the keeper (shelter behind pillars in gusts)
message.skyabyss.raid.SR5.miss: Wrong, or too late. Watch again
message.skyabyss.raid.SR6.gust: A gust is coming! Get behind a pillar
